blocks.text: You can connect your OneLogin organization to Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
A user with Account Owner or Admin privileges is required to connect Advanced SSPM to your OneLogin organization.
To connect your OneLogin organization to Advanced SSPM:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the SaaS Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select OneLogin.
In the Add Integration window, enter the OneLogin subdomain (e.g., acme), Client ID, and Client Secret, and then click Connect.

blocks.text: To create the API credentials, refer to the OneLogin documentation.
Your OneLogin organization is now connected. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page.
